risk_summary: The excerpt has a strongly promotional tone, emphasizing customer wins, transformation progress, cost reductions, and pandemic resilience. Credit-relevant concerns include full borrowing of the revolving credit facility, reliance on debt refinancing, supply-chain uncertainty, and incomplete contract-value disclosures such as "$11" and "$13" without units. Repeated references to liquidity and DN Now benefits provide some risk context but limited quantified detail on leverage, covenant headroom, or execution risk.
